blocks.text: More than two decades after its release, Filipino-American singer Jay R’s ‘Bakit Pa Ba?’ is getting a new rendition with Grammy-winning singer-songwriter Lil Eddie. Titled ‘Bakit Pa Ba? (MT Taglish Version),’ the collaboration reimagines the OPM classic with a mix of Tagalog and English. According to the R&B singer, the idea came from Lil Eddie while the two artists were in the Philippines promoting their previous Taglish collaboration of his ‘Statue.’ He suggested giving ‘Bakit Pa Ba?’ the same format, transforming Jay R’s original solo track into a duet. “I was like, ‘Bro, we should do the same thing with ‘Bakit […]...
